buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only.

4. Inspection Materials shall be guaranteed for 12 months from the date of commissioning or 18 months from the date of supply whichever is earlier. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SN ATC (PR No. 100282369) 1 Not Applicable 2 If any seller/bidder has any clarification against technical specification or otherwise on an y aspect of this bid, they can raise their representation against the same by using the Re presentation Window provided in the bid details field in Seller dashboard after logging in as a seller within the time period after bid publication as allowed by GeM. Clarification as ked through any means other than above, may not be considered by NTPC. 3 Bidder may quote as per "Technical Specification" and/ or spec sheet attached for each li ne item/ schedule. In case of any contradiction between Category/ BOQ Item description and "Technical Specification" of the item(s) attached in the tender, TECHNICAL SPECIFIC ATION OF THAT ITEM SHOULD BE CONSIDERED FOR THE SUBMISSION OF OFFER AND SA ME SHALL BE CONSIDERED FOR EVALUATION PURPOSE AT OUR END. The details mentio ned in the detailed Technical specification shall be considered final for the offer/ bid/ tec hnical evaluation. Bidder has to quote make and model in GeM as per option available in GeM during submi ssion of offer after meeting all the technical specification of tender. After opening of bids , any change in vendor's quoted make or model in their bid cannot be done and any suc h request will be rejected. In the event of an order, vendor’s quoted make and model in t heir bid will also get automatically populated in the GEM Purchase order. Also, MSE & MII benefits will be given exclusively based on documents submitted in reference to the "quoted make and model" submitted in the GeM bid. 4 Guarantee/Warranty: 12 months from the date of use/commissioning or 18 months fro m the date of supply, whichever is earlier. (The Guarantee/ Warranty Terms and Conditio ns shall be applicable to the material supplied against the PO. No separate Guarantee/ W arranty Certificate is required to be submitted by the Supplier along with the material. Th e Guarantee / Warranty terms and condition shall be binding on the supplier). If any high er Guarantee/warranty mentioned in the technical specification the same shall be applica ble 5 Common IP Addresses: - Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing and presenting to the buyer the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s) /Seller(s). T he received bids having matching/common IP address with either Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or B uyer, shall be outrightly rejected & shall not be considered for further evaluation.

6 During techno-commercial evaluation of offer, clarification/ reply to the queries (if asked by NTPC) given by bidder will be considered an integral part of the GeM purchase order and the vendor will be liable to execute the PO also in accordance with the same. Further more, in the event subsequent clarification(s)/query(ies) are sought and bidder fails to re spond or responds with incorrect / inadequate or non-compliant information, the bid will be liable to be rejected. Subsequent representation(s) may not be accepted in such case s. 7 The Bidder shall be held solely responsible for non-submission of bids on the e-tender po rtal due to any reasons within the due date/ time, The Procuring Entity/NTPC shall not be held responsible or liable in any manner for the same. Bidders shall follow the guidelines/instructions available on the e-tender portal and are a dvised to submit their bids well before the due date and time to avoid any inconvenience or risk of non-submission. All post award communication/ grievance will be addressed to consignee. In case of non- resolution of the issue, matter can be escalated along with previous correspondence(s) t o email id:- vendor_grievance_cpg2@ntpc.co.in. No communication done with this email ID at the pre-award stage can be entertained. 8 Payment terms: As per GeM GTC. 9 Make in India (MII): Definitions, Explanatory Notes, Application of Purchase Preference in various scenarios & Formats with regards to Local Content are available in Annexue-8 of the ATC attachme nt uploaded along with the tender. Declaration of Local Content is a self-certification which is submitted by a bidder clearly i ndicating the following details (Annexure-8): · Description of Goods and Services offered. · Whether meeting Class-I/Class-II/Non-Local Supplier as per tender terms and conditions. · % of Local Value Addition. · Location at which local value addition is made. Complaints pertaining to Local content declaration/value addition, if any, may be address ed by the complainant to the committee constituted by MoP, for independent verification of self-declarations and auditor's / accountant's certificates on random basis and in the c ase of complaints. The composition of the committee is as specified in MoP Order ref. no. A-1/2021-FSC-Part(5) dated 16.11.2021. In case of complaint made by any bidder to the Standing Committee constituted by MoP, the tendering process will continue unless there is specific instruction/communication fro m the Standing Committee/MoP/CEA to put the tendering process on hold. Annexure 8: Declaration regarding Local Content as per the Employer’s format, for grant ing of purchase preference/ acceptance as Class-I/ II Local Supplier:

In case a bidder does not submit the aforesaid declaration or statement/ any declaration like ‘later’, ‘to be furnished later’, ‘NA’ etc. are indicated by the bidder, then the Bidder is liable not to be considered as a local supplier and may not be eligible for any purchase preference/ bid is liable to be considered non-responsive and may be rejected. Further, Bidder shall be required to submit a certificate from the statutory auditor or cost auditor (in the case the bidder is a company) or from a practicing cost accountant or pra cticing chartered accountant (in respect of bidders other than companies) giving the percentage of local content at the time of execution of the project, or where it is not pos sible to provide certification at the time of execution of project, during execution prior to submission of last bill for payment.# In case aforesaid Certificate furnished by Contracto r/Vendor is not in line with the declaration in respect of Local content in their bid, same may be treated as false declaration and may be dealt in line with the Fraud Prevention Policy of NTPC. Bidders (in case manufacturers) are required to submit any of the following documents v iz. Latest Annual Report or NSIC / SSI / BIS License/ ISO Certificate / Any Other Statutory Document as a proof of manufacturer of the offered product. In case bidder is a dealer/ t rader, they are required to submit Declaration of Local Content duly signed by manufact urer along with submission of proof of manufacturing as elaborated above. For tenders having lumpsum/ package evaluation involving supply of multiple items, wei ghted average of all items to be taken while calculating the local content of the package. In case of Procurement of Instruments such as Testing Instrument/ Measuring Instrumen t / Analysers etc. or if required by the buyer, bidder may be asked to furnish following su pporting documents for Proof of Manufacturing of the specified Item(s) and/or Place of Lo cal Value Addition: I. Latest Annual Report; or II. NSIC/ DIC/SSI Certificate; or III. BIS License/ ISO Certificate; or IV. Factory License/ Consent to Operate; or V. NABL Accreditation Certificate of Manufacturer’s Laboratory; or VI. Vendor Assessment Report issued by GeM Authority; or VII. Any Other Statutory/Relevant Document as proof of manufacturing/Local value Addit ion. 10 CONFLICT OF INTEREST: A bidder shall not have conflict of interest with other bidders. Such conflict of interest ca n lead to anti- competitive practices to the detriment of Employer’s interests. A bidder m ay be considered to have a conflict of interest with one or more parties in this bidding pr ocess, if: a) they directly or indirectly control, or are controlled by or are under common control of another entity; or

b) they have the same legal representative/agent for purposes of their bids; or c) they have relationship with each other, directly or through common third party(ies), th at puts them in a position to have access to information about or influence on the bid of another Bidder; or d) Bidder and/or any of its allied entity(ies), which directly or indirectly control(s) or is(ar e) controlled by or is(are) under common control of another entity, has(ve) participated as a consultant in the preparation of the design or technical specifications of the contract that is the subject of the tender; or e) Bidder participates in more than one bid in this bidding process. f) In cases of agents quoting on behalf of their principal manufacturers/service providers, one agent cannot represent two manufacturers/service providers or quote on their behal f in a particular tender enquiry. One manufacturer/service provider can also authorize on ly one agent. There can be only one bid from the following: i) The principal manufacturer/service provider directly or through one Indian agent on his behalf; and ii) Indian/foreign agent on behalf of only one principal. For the purposes of this clause the term ‘control’ shall have the following meaning: “Control” shall include the right to appoint majority of the directors or to control the man agement or policy decisions exercisable by a person or persons acting individually or in c oncert, directly or indirectly, including by virtue of their shareholding or management rig hts or shareholders’ agreements or voting agreements or in any other manner. Vendor has to submit CONFLICT OF INTEREST declaration in bid during submission offer as detail as “We confirm that we have read and understood the Buyer Added Bid Specifi c ATC Clause regarding “Conflict of Interest” and our bid is in compliance to this clause. I n case it is established that we have provided any false information in pursuance of the aforesaid Clause, while competing for this contract, then our bid shall be rejected and bi d security shall be forfeited. We also understand that in case we become successful bidd er, if it is established that we have not complied with terms of aforesaid Clause, during e xecution of contract, this would be considered as fraudulent practice as mentioned in pa ra 5.1 (j) of “Policy for Debarment from Business Dealings” and shall be dealt accordingl y.” Note: Policy for Debarment from Business Dealings available at "https://ntpc.co.in/sites/d efault/files/policy- documents/Policy_for_Debarment_from_Business_Dealings.pdf". (Compliance to “ Conflict of Interest” provisions) We confirm that we have read and understood the ITB* Clause regarding “Conflict of Int erest” and our bid is in compliance to this clause. In case it is established that we have provided any false information in pursuance of the aforesaid ITB* Clause, while competing for this contract, then our bid shall be rejected an d bid security shall be forfeited. We also understand that in case we become successful bidder, if it is established that w e have not complied with terms of aforesaid ITB Clause, during execution of contract, thi s would be considered as fraudulent practice as mentioned in para 5.1 (j) of “Policy for D

ebarment from Business Dealings” and shall be dealt accordingly. 11 Risk purchase- In the event of Suppliers failure to supply the material of acceptable qu ality in scheduled delivery period, NTPC reserves the right to procure the materials from any other source at the Suppliers risk and cost and the difference in cost shall be borne b y the Supplier. Further, NTPC shall retain the right of forfeiture of CPG/ PBG and or any ot her action as deemed fit. 12 Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI): Not Applicable Vendor, along with material, shall submit test certificate / internal inspection reports as per attachment STCR. 13 EMD BG: NOT APPLICABLE: 14 Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) : NOT APPLICABLE 15 MSME benefit (purchase preference) is to be given as per following conditions: In case of procurement of goods/ services, preferences to MSEs whose quoted prices are within L1 (non-MSEs) +15% range (subject to matching of L1 price) will be given in the following order: a) SC-ST Women MSEs b) SC-ST other than Women MSEs c) Women MSEs d) Other MSEs The MSE order quantity will be as per following: i. Where the requirement is Not-Splitable: 100% of contract quantity will be awarded to MSEs. ii. Where the requirement is Splitable: 25% of contract quantity will be awarded to MSEs. In case of more than one MSEs (for the same category) are within range of L1+15 % price, then 25% of tendered quantity will be divided equally amongst them. . 7.
